title: Absolute Regression
description:
Absolute Regression
Novel:
“Send me to the past.”
That’s how the first step toward revenge began.
Manhwa:
“Please send me back to the past.”
If he cannot not kill that person in this era, he just needs to go back to the past.
The man used the “Great Regression Technique” to cross time, going back to the past he desired so much.
The “Unrivaled Swordsman” who had lost everything, his family, friends, and life.
This is his first step to taking his revenge.
